objective: Test a physically distinct short-component precision/recall mechanism and maximize honest nested pooled reciprocal OOF.
reason_exploratory: The mechanism family was chosen after reading competition discussions and an open notebook; absolute public-notebook proxy scores are not imported as evidence.

dataflow.forward: EXP130 source-44b6 model frozen EXP152 candidate caches evaluated on all 12 held-out 6bba movies
dataflow.reverse: EXP137 source-6bba model frozen EXP152 candidate caches evaluated on all 12 held-out 44b6 movies

rescue.source: Yusuke Togashi open notebook mechanism, independently reimplemented on our frozen reciprocal caches

primary_protocol: Within each direction and held-out movie, select an arm using pooled score on the other 11 movies. Aggregate only the 24 held-out selected rows.
control_gate: The no_filter row for every movie and metric must reproduce EXP152 registered_hungarian within 1e-12.
interpretation: A positive nested pooled delta is retained as useful exploratory OOF evidence. Per-movie, per-embryo, node recall, edge and division components remain diagnostics and are not vetoes.
